title: Affine Quantization, Roofline Model, and Simulated Latency Percentile Profiling for Edge Hardware
objective: Standardized analytical evaluation of quantization (FP32 to INT8/INT4), roofline arithmetic intensity limits, and simulated P50/P95/P99 latency distribution under modeled thermal throttling
hypothesis: Affine INT8 quantization retains >= 99% mAP accuracy relative to FP32 baseline while achieving >= 1.6x modeled latency speedup and 4x memory reduction on bandwidth-limited edge memory architectures

dataset.name: COCO 2017 Edge Benchmark Subset / MLPerf Mobile Vision
dataset.sensorProvenance: Standard RGB edge camera stream at 640x640 resolution
dataset.citation: Lin et al., Microsoft COCO: Common Objects in Context, ECCV 2014; Reddi et al., MLPerf Mobile Inference Benchmark, 2021

hardware.gpuModel: Simulated Edge NPU / Arm Cortex-A76 NPU Subsystem

knownLimitations: Sub-8-bit quantization (INT4/INT2) requires post-training calibration or quantization-aware training (QAT) to prevent accuracy collapse in classification heads.
Reported latency metrics and speedup ratios are analytical Roofline model simulations under modeled thermal throttling, not direct physical silicon edge measurements.
author: Tim Riset Visi Komputer ITERA
